mapper.select: select t.id, t.name, t.description, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_time, (select count(*) from crm_data_table_row r where r.data_table_id = t.id) as row_count from crm_data_table t where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by t.create_time desc
select count(*) from crm_data_table where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and name = #{name}
select count(*) from crm_data_table where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and name = #{name} and id != #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: insert into crm_data_table (id, tenant_id, name, description, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{createBy}, coalesce(#{createTime}, now()), coalesce(#{updateTime}, now()))
mapper.update: update crm_data_table set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, update_time = coalesce(#{updateTime}, now()) where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: delete from crm_data_table where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
